decisions.reason: The product has its own page, which signals management commitment, and a single year on the market is too short to judge it against aspirations, so slack in a mature mid-sized weaver lets it continue.
It is only mentioned on the website, so its visibility and commitment are weaker, but one year of evidence does not yet show a shortfall large enough to trigger problemistic search and removal.
Flame-retardant curtain fabric serves the stable contract market for hotels and public buildings, and it has a dedicated page, so it likely meets aspirations and fits the firm's core competencies.
It is only mentioned and its wool-blend costs are high in a weak German textile market, but it is too early to see a clear shortfall, so the firm keeps it for now.

It is a niche product with low visibility that overlaps with Product B, which makes it a candidate for pruning, but without evidence of failure, bounded rationality and inertia favour keeping it another year.
